description: The microcontroller boards Mokxi simulates, all 74 of them, or only one family's, with each board's type for the "board" field, the code it takes, its pin names, its page on mokxi.com and Mokxi's own picture of it. The optional "family" narrows the list to one family or kind of board ("ESP32", "Arduino", "Raspberry Pi"). Returns the count and the boards.

family.description: Optional. A board family, name or type to narrow the list to, such as "esp32", "arduino", "raspberry pi", "stm32" or "rp2040". Left out, every board.

name: list_boards
title: List boards
